text: E S A F Small Finance Bank wrote off six hundred and twenty five crore of loans in three months.
Clue one. The filing mentions it to explain growth. Without the write off, loans would have grown twenty eight percent, not twenty five.
Clue two. Flip it. That's two point six percent of the entire loan book, off the books in one quarter.
The twist. Ujjivan, nearly twice the size, wrote off forty three crore.
Clean up, or warning sign? The results will show the cost. Back to the napkin.
